policy.method: Fetch public page bytes; hash exact response; when first seen, materially different bytes, HTTP status change, or missing snapshot, request a Wayback Save Page Now capture.
cautions: A byte-level change is an alert, not proof of deliberate amendment: templates, analytics, timestamps, content delivery, and encoding may change.
A failed request is not a deletion; keep the last successful digest and report the failed check.
A Wayback calendar URL is not a confirmed snapshot. Only a recorded snapshot URL/Wayback timestamp counts as a confirmed capture.
The monitoring set is deliberately small at first. Add URLs only after linking them to a specific claim or source record and validating the exact page.
